privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: $t(app.name) is built to keep your data on your device. We do not operate servers that collect your recipes, meal plans, or grocery lists.
privacy.contact: Questions? Reach the author on GitHub:

sections.title: Summary
sections.body: $t(app.name) does not require an account. We do not sell your data. We do not use analytics, advertising networks, crash reporting SDKs, or third-party trackers in the app or on this website.

sections.title: Data stored on your device
sections.body: Recipes, meal schedules, grocery lists, and app settings are stored locally on your iPhone or iPad using Apple's on-device storage frameworks. This data never leaves your device unless you explicitly share it through iOS share sheets.

sections.title: This website
sections.body: This landing page does not use cookies, analytics, or embedded third-party widgets. We do not collect personal information when you browse cook-gpt.pages.dev.

sections.title: Third parties
sections.body: The App Store download link sends you to Apple. GitHub links on this site send you to GitHub. We do not integrate any other third-party services.

sections.title: Open source
sections.body: $t(app.name) is open source. You can review the application code on GitHub to verify how data is handled.

sections.title: Changes
sections.body: If this policy changes, we will update this page. Continued use of the app or website after changes constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.

docs.title: Documentation
docs.subtitle: Get started with $t(app.name) on iPhone or iPad.
installSteps: Open the app — sample recipes and a meal schedule are included.
Explore Recipes, Meals, Groceries, and Settings from the tab bar.
quickStartSteps: Browse recipes and tap one to see ingredients and steps.
Start a step timer — it appears on your Lock Screen while you cook.
Open Meals to schedule or auto-plan your week.
Generate a grocery list from your planned meals in Groceries.
